# Services

State the services the supplier will provide. Give the scope, the
deliverables, and any exclusions. Use one clause per service so the
agreement stays easy to read.

# Fees and payment

State the fees and the payment terms. Name the currency, the
invoicing cycle, and the payment window. Add late payment terms if
the parties agreed them.

# Term and termination

State when the agreement starts and how it ends. Give the notice
period and the grounds for early termination.

# Liability

State the liability limits. Set the cap and the excluded losses.

# General

Record the remaining boilerplate: confidentiality, data protection,
subcontracting, assignment, amendment, and notices.
